name: AbstractWebsocketClient
documentation:
Abstract base class for all WebSocket-based clients in the Fluxzero Java client.

This class provides robust connection management, message dispatching, result handling, batching, metrics publishing, and ping-based health checking. It underpins core components such as {@code WebsocketGatewayClient}, providing the shared infrastructure needed for durable, resilient WebSocket communication with the Fluxzero Runtime.

Core Responsibilities

  • Establishing and maintaining WebSocket connections with automatic reconnection support
  • Managing message sending and batching via {@link Request} and {@link RequestBatch}
  • Receiving and processing incoming {@link RequestResult} and {@link ResultBatch} messages
  • Supporting command guarantees (e.g., SENT, STORED) with retries and backpressure handling
  • Sending periodic ping frames to detect connection drops
  • Integrating with the Fluxzero metrics infrastructure for custom performance telemetry

Key Features

  • Session Pooling: Maintains multiple concurrent sessions to handle high-throughput scenarios
  • Request Backlogs: Each session has a backlog to buffer and batch outgoing requests
  • Ping Scheduling: Scheduled tasks detect broken sessions using WebSocket pings
  • Auto Retry: Failed requests are retried if the session is closed unexpectedly
  • Async Result Handling: Responses are handled on a separate thread pool to avoid blocking I/O
  • Metrics Publishing: Optional emission of message-related metrics based on configuration
@see WebsocketGatewayClient @see Command @see WebSocketRequest @see SessionPool @see Request @see RequestResult @see ResultBatch

methods.name: handlePong
methods.documentation:
Invoked asynchronously after the pong deadline has been acknowledged on the protocol callback path.
 Subclasses may override this method for observation but should not perform liveness bookkeeping themselves.

methods.name: jfrResultType
methods.documentation: Classifies decoded results for optional protocol-specific JFR diagnostics.

methods.name: maxRequestBatchSize
methods.documentation: Returns the maximum transport chunk for the supplied requests.

methods.name: outstandingRequest
methods.documentation: Returns the still-outstanding request for a decoded response, or {@code null} when it is no longer pending.

methods.name: payloadCodecs
methods.documentation: Returns compact payload codecs owned by this concrete protocol client.

methods.name: prepareRequest
methods.documentation: Captures a request without releasing it to the websocket queue yet.

methods.name: prepareRequest
methods.documentation: Captures a request and result context without releasing it to the websocket queue yet.

methods.name: prepareResults
methods.documentation:
Allows a specialized client to complete request-owned work for a decoded result group before individual request
 futures are released.

methods.name: restoreResultContext
methods.documentation: Restores context from the request that belongs to a decoded result before grouped result preparation starts.

methods.name: restoreResultContext
methods.documentation: Restores request-owned context that a specialized compact response deliberately omits from the wire.

methods.name: retryOutstandingRequestsDelay
methods.documentation: Delay before outstanding requests from a closed session are resent on a replacement session.

methods.name: send
methods.documentation: Sends a request with context retained locally until its result is decoded.

methods.name: sendPreparedRequests
methods.documentation: Releases prepared requests per selected session in one queue operation.

methods.name: startRequestBatchEvent
methods.documentation: Starts an optional request-batch event owned by the concrete protocol client.
